answer: Random beacon audit: a verifiable random function picks 5% of identities each epoch for proof in 2 epochs. Selection is unpredictable and unforgeable; the ivory audit record is public. A miss freezes rewards 6 epochs; two misses slash 50% of stake. No island of hoarded identities can hide: no holder predicts the target. Cost: 1,000 clones lock 120,000 units; each round absence costs about 6,000, and the delta between upkeep and hoarding grows.
